label: Any two graph-relative sources are equal; no source exists merely by this…, by Direct-proof
meaning: Mathlib equivalence_join turns upstream confluence into equivalence of having a common finite upstream extension. Every graph edge lies in that equivalence, so EqvGen causal connectivity joins any two sources. A source admits no nontrivial upstream path, forcing the common extension to equal each source. No WF, nonemptiness, acyclicity, necessary existence or divine predicate is used.
